name: mirage
text:
I read your 4:35 PM report and the engine's log. Here's what they show and what they don't.
What they show: GitHub's list is steady, 14 to 26 bets on every scan. On your phone the same list shrinks, for example 14 to 2 or 9 to 0, several times in 10 minutes. The dropped bets have no price to buy at when your phone re-reads them from Novig a moment later (no one has a bid on the other side), so they leave the list. They come back when a seller appears.
That fits 'nobody was selling': the offer the scan saw is gone seconds later. My read is that these offers on Novig are thin and short-lived right now, and it likely began recently because of how Novig's market makers are behaving. That is my inference, not proven. Nothing in the report shows a broken price on our side.
Two other things in the report: your phone is rate-limited by Novig (429s on fills), and it keeps asking GitHub for a bids file that doesn't exist, every 10 s. I'll fix the second now, and I'm adding a log of each listed bet's ask appearing and disappearing, so the next report shows how long offers last and settles this.
